The adjacent ratio comparisons at both ends, including m=1,2, close the induction from (1,0,…). Thus the same action attains every finite-horizon exit minimum. Every stage finishes a.s. even under an adaptive controller, by positive-probability blocks of forced same-direction moves. Conditional stochastic dominance and sequential quantile coupling give whole-cover dominance. Under the proposed policy history-independent folded stage laws give independence even with history-dependent symmetric tie choices. From the one-level passage decomposition, given upper-level mean e and variance v, the next lower ones are e'=(4+e)/3 and v'=v/3+(e+e')²/4, with top data (1,0) or (4/3,4/9). This gives both parity formulas; deficit sums are 57/4 and 12, giving 6n−129/4 plus the stated tail error. A common down/up Bernoulli sequence dominates the folded stages by the biased walk from 1 with the displayed generating function; no bounded third-moment or Lyapunov gap remains.
